Test Case Title: Valid admin credentials return a token
Test Steps: 1. Send POST /auth with the admin credentials.
Test Data: username admin, password password123 (public demo credentials)
Expected Result: Status 200. The body has a token that is a string with more than 5 characters.

Test Case Title: Wrong password returns "Bad credentials" and no token
Test Steps: 1. Send POST /auth with username admin and password wrong.
Expected Result: Status 200 (this API reports the failure in the body). The body reason is "Bad credentials" and there is no token.

Test Steps: 1. Send POST /auth with an empty JSON body.

Test Case Title: A fresh token is accepted by a protected endpoint
Preconditions: A booking created by the test (unique last name)
Test Steps: 1. Create a token. 2. Send DELETE /booking/:id with the token cookie.
Test Data: a token created with admin / password123
Expected Result: Status 201, so the token is accepted.
